প্রশ্ন প্রণয়নে:
জনাব সালেহ আহমেদ
৩৫তম বিসিএস (সাধারণ শিক্ষা)
প্রভাষক, ইংরেজি বিভাগ।
মৌলভীবাজার সরকারি কলেজ।

English Wizard.question: ১) None but the graduates were allowed to apply for the post. (Make it affirmative)
English Wizard.option1: ক) The graduates were allowed to apply for the post.
English Wizard.option2: খ) The graduates were allowed only to apply for the post.
English Wizard.option3: গ) Only the graduates were allowed to apply for the post.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) The graduates were allowed to apply only for the post.
English Wizard.exp: Negative বাক্যে None but থাকলে Affirmative এ None but এর ঠিক পরের Noun টির পূর্বে only বা পরে alone বসে।

English Wizard.question: ২) You must be submissive to the Almighty. (Make it Negative)
English Wizard.option1: ক) You cannot be submissive to the Almighty.
English Wizard.option2: খ) You cannot but being submissive to the Almighty.
English Wizard.option3: গ) You cannot but submissive to the Almighty.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) You cannot help being submissive to the Almighty.
English Wizard.exp:
must এর পরিবর্তে Negative বাক্য ২ভাবে তৈরি হতে পারে :
cannot but + Verb এর Base Form 
cannot help + Verb+ing
cannot but /cannot help  = না করে না পারা

English Wizard.question: ৩) Every cloud has a silver lining. (Make it Negative)
English Wizard.option1: ক) There is no cloud but a silver a lining.
English Wizard.option2: খ) There is no cloud without has a silver lining.
English Wizard.option3: গ) There is no cloud without a silver lining.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) There is no cloud without being a silver lining.
English Wizard.exp:
Every + Noun থাকলে negative করার সময় সাধারণত Structure হয়:
• There is no + Subject (Noun) + but + Verb + Object/ Extension.
• There is no + Subject (Noun) + which does not + Verb + Object/ Extension

যখন Verb হিসেবে have/has থাকে, তখন পূর্বোক্তভাবেও করা যায়  অথবা এভাবেও করা যায় - 
• There is no + Subject + without + (Object)/ (having + Object)

অতএব, বাক্যটার সঠিক Negative হতে পারে :
- There is no cloud but has a silver a lining.
- There is no cloud which does not have a silver a lining.
- There is no cloud without a silver lining.
- There is no cloud without having a silver lining.

এখানে কেবল (গ) সঠিকভাবে ব্যবহৃত হয়েছে।

English Wizard.question: ৪) It is seen only in Cox’s Bazar. (Make it Negative)
English Wizard.option1: ক) It is nothing but seen in Cox’s Bazar.
English Wizard.option2: খ) It is seen nowhere but in Cox’s Bazar.
English Wizard.option3: গ) It is alone not seen in Cox’s Bazar.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Nothing is seen but in Cox’s Bazar.
English Wizard.exp: স্থানের আগে only থাকলে এর পরিবর্তে nowhere but বসে।

English Wizard.question: ৫) Both Tom and John were involved in the matter. (Make it Negative)
English Wizard.option1: ক) Not only Tom but also John was involved in the matter.
English Wizard.option2: খ) Not only Tom and John were involved in the matter.
English Wizard.option3: গ) Neither Tom but also John was involved in the matter.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Tom and John alone was not involved in the matter.
English Wizard.exp:
Both .... and এর পরিবর্তে Not only ..... but also বসে। 
তবে Both .... and এর পরে plural verb বসে। কিন্তু Not only ..... but also এর ক্ষেত্রে কেবল but also এর পরের Noun অনুযায়ী Verb বসে। এখানে but also এর পরে Singular Noun থাকায় Verb – was বসবে।

English Wizard.question: ৬) There is not much water in the pond. (Make it Affirmative)
English Wizard.option1: ক) There is little water in the pond.
English Wizard.option2: খ) There is a few water in the pond.
English Wizard.option3: গ) There is a little water in the pond.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) There is enough water in the pond.
English Wizard.exp:
not much এর পরিবর্তে a little বসে। 
a little = অল্প পরিমাণ
little = এত অল্প যে নেই বললেই চলে
a few = অল্প কিছু , এটা uncountable noun এর আ‌গে ব‌সে না।
enough = যথেষ্ট

English Wizard.question: ৭) The problem was so tough that he could not find out a solution. (Make it Affirmative)
English Wizard.option1: ক) The problem was too tough to find out a solution.
English Wizard.option2: খ) The problem was very tough to find out a solution.
English Wizard.option3: গ) The problem was too tough for him to find out a solution.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) The problem was so tough for him to find out a solution.
English Wizard.exp:
Negative বাক্যে so ...... that থাকলে Affirmative এ এর পরিবর্তে too .... to বসে। 
ক- তে কর্তার উল্লেখ নেই, তাই এটা ভুল। তাই সঠিক উত্তর কেবল (গ)।

English Wizard.question: ৮) There was no traitor but ultimately had to atone for his treachery. (Make it Affirmative)
English Wizard.option1: ক) There was a traitor who ultimately had to atone for his treachery.
English Wizard.option2: খ) There was every traitor but ultimately had to atone for his treachery.
English Wizard.option3: গ) Every traitor ultimately atoned for his treachery.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Every traitor ultimately had to atone for his treachery.
English Wizard.exp:
There was no .... but থাকলে এর পরিবর্তে Every বসে।
গ-তে Modal Auxiliary (had to) বাদ পড়েছে, তাই এটা ভুল।

English Wizard.question: ৯) It was August and we reached there with heavy hearts. (Make it Simple)
English Wizard.option1: ক) On August, we reached there with heavy hearts.
English Wizard.option2: খ) In August, we reached there with heavy hearts.
English Wizard.option3: গ) At August, we reached there with heavy hearts.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) For August, we reached there with heavy hearts.
English Wizard.exp: মাসের নামের পূর্বে In বসে।

English Wizard.question: ১০) Take medicines regularly, else you may fall terribly sick. (Make it Complex)
English Wizard.option1: ক) If you not take medicines regularly, you may fall terribly sick.
English Wizard.option2: খ) Unless you not take medicines regularly, you may fall terribly sick.
English Wizard.option3: গ) If you do not take medicines regularly, you may fall terribly sick.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) If you take medicines regularly, you may not fall terribly sick.
English Wizard.exp:
else, otherwise, or = অন্যথায়, নতুবা
Compound Sentence এ বাক্যের প্রথম অংশ Imperative হলে, Complex Sentence এ If বসে।
আর মাঝে else, otherwise, or থাকলে If Clause টা Negative হয় (অথবা Unless + Affirmative Form হয়) ।
(মাঝে and থাকলে affirmative হয়। 13 নং প্রশ্ন দ্রষ্টব্য।)

English Wizard.question: ১১) They had helped us a lot and we just tried to return their benevolence. (Make it Complex)
English Wizard.option1: ক) When they had helped us a lot, we just tried to return their benevolence.
English Wizard.option2: খ) We just tried to return their benevolence, for they had helped us a lot.
English Wizard.option3: গ) Since they had helped us a lot, we just tried to return their benevolence.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) If they had helped us a lot, we just tried to return their benevolence.
English Wizard.exp:
বাক্যের অর্থ : তারা আমাদেরকে অনেক সাহায্য করেছে; আর আমরা শুধু চেষ্টা করেছি তাদের উদারতার প্রতিদান দিতে। 
উভয় Clause এর মধ্যে সম্পর্ক হচ্ছে কারণ- ফলাফল এর। অর্থাৎ তারা আমাদের অনেক সাহায্য করেছিল এ কারণেই আমরা তাদের প্রতিদান দিতে চেষ্টা করেছি। 
Complex Sentence এ কারণ বর্ণনাকারী Clause এর আগে ‍As/Since/Because বসবে।  তাই সঠিক উত্তর (গ)।
খ- কারণ অর্থে for -Conjunction হিসেবে ব্যবহার করলে সেটা Compound Sentence হয়, Complex নয়।

English Wizard.question: ১২) I read a book and it was very instructive. (Make it Simple)
English Wizard.option1: ক) I read a book very instructively.
English Wizard.option2: খ) I read a very instructive book.
English Wizard.option3: গ) Being very instructive, I read a book.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) I read a book for its being very instructive.
English Wizard.exp:
বাক্যের অর্থ : আমি একটা বই পড়েছিলাম আর এটা ছিল খুবই শিক্ষণীয়। 
and it is/was + (Adjective) / (Adverb + Adjective) থাকলে, Complex Sentence এ  (Adjective) / (Adverb + Adjective) টা Related Noun এর পূর্বে বসে।

English Wizard.question: ১৩) Go through the text carefully and you can cut a good figure in the exam. ( Make it Complex)
English Wizard.option1: ক) As you go through the text carefully, you can cut a good figure in the exam.
English Wizard.option2: খ) Go through the text carefully if you can cut a good figure in the exam.
English Wizard.option3: গ) You can cut a good figure in the exam provided you go through the text carefully.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Go through the text carefully, then you can cut a good figure in the exam.
English Wizard.exp:
বাক্যের অর্থ : পাঠ্যবই ভালোভাবে পড়ো এবং (এতে) তুমি পরীক্ষায় ভালো করতে পারবে। 
Compound Sentence এ বাক্যের প্রথম অংশ Imperative হলে, Complex Sentence এ Imperative Clause এর পূর্বে If/ in case/ provided ইত্যাদি বসে Assertive এ পরিণত হয়। আর মাঝে and থাকলে Clause টা affirmative হয় (or থাকলে Negative হয়)। Complex Sentence এ Clause গুলো আগে-পরে বসালে অর্থের কোনো পরিবর্তন হয় না। এ হিসেবে সঠিক উত্তর (গ)।

English Wizard.question: ১৪) The enemies entered the territory and at that very moment the border guards attacked them. (Make it Complex)
English Wizard.option1: ক) When the enemies entered the territory, the border guards attacked them.
English Wizard.option2: খ) No sooner had the enemies entered the territory, the border guards attacked them.
English Wizard.option3: গ) As soon as the enemies entered the territory than the border guards attacked them.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) As soon as the enemies entered the territory, the border guards attacked them.
English Wizard.exp:
বাক্যের অর্থ : শত্রুরা রাজ্যের ভূখণ্ডে প্রবেশ করল এবং ঠিক ঐ মুহূর্তেই বর্ডার গার্ডরা তাদের আক্রমণ করলো।
Compound Sentence এ ‘and at that very moment = ঠিক ঐ মুহূর্তে’ থাকলে Complex Sentence এ As soon as (করতে না করতেই/ হতে না হতেই) বসে।
As soon as দিয়ে বাক্য শুরু হলে উভয় Clause কে আলাদা করার জন্য কেবল Comma বসে।

English Wizard.question: ১৫) Do now or never. (Make it Complex)
English Wizard.option1: ক) Unless you don’t do now, you can never do.
English Wizard.option2: খ) If you do now, you can never do.
English Wizard.option3: গ) If you don’t do now, you can never do.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Do now if you have never done.
English Wizard.exp:
বাক্যের অর্থ : এখনই করো নতুবা কখনো পারবে না।
Compound Sentence এ বাক্যের প্রথম অংশ Imperative হলে, Complex Sentence এ If বসে। আর মাঝে or থাকলে If Clause টা Negative হয়। (and থাকলে affirmative হয়। 13 নং প্রশ্ন দ্রষ্টব্য।) Complex Sentence এ Clause গুলো পূর্ণরূপে বসে।

English Wizard.question: ১৬) Jubaer not only left the party but also joined the opposition. (Make it simple)
English Wizard.option1: ক) In spite of leaving the party, Jubaer joined the opposition.
English Wizard.option2: খ) Beside leaving the party, Jubaer joined the opposition.
English Wizard.option3: গ) With leaving the party, Jubaer joined the opposition.
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Besides leaving the party, Jubaer joined the opposition.
English Wizard.exp:
বাক্যের অর্থ  : যোবায়ের কেবল দল ত্যাগ করেনি বরং প্রতিপক্ষ দলে যোগদানও করেছে।
not only ..... but also এর পরিবর্তে Simple Sentence এ besides (ছাড়াও) বসে। 
In spite of = সত্ত্বেও
Beside = পাশে
With = সাথে

English Wizard.question: ১৭) How a yellow dog can tell the truth! Here, ‘Yellow dog’ means –
English Wizard.option1: ক) Coward
English Wizard.option2: খ) Prejudiced
English Wizard.option3: গ) Weak
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) Unnatural
English Wizard.exp: Yellow dog = ভীরু, কাপুরুষ = coward

English Wizard.question: ১৮) ‘Nip in the bud’ means –
English Wizard.option1: ক) to put an end in initial stages
English Wizard.option2: খ) to do something destructive
English Wizard.option3: গ) to take care of the children
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) to begin well
English Wizard.exp: Nip in the bud = অঙ্কুরে বিনষ্ট করা = to put an end in initial stages

English Wizard.question: ১৯) The expression 'take into account' means –
English Wizard.option1: ক) count numbers
English Wizard.option2: খ) consider
English Wizard.option3: গ) think seriously
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) asses
English Wizard.exp:
Take into account – to give consideration to (unexpected circumstances or contingencies) = consider (বিবেচনা করা)।
Source: merriam-webster.com

English Wizard.question: ২০) What is the meaning of the expression ‘To read between the lines’?
English Wizard.option1: ক) to concentrate
English Wizard.option2: খ) to suspect
English Wizard.option3: গ) to read carefully
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) to grasp the hidden meaning
English Wizard.exp: To read between the lines – ভাল করে পড়ে অন্তর্নিহিত অর্থ বুঝে নেওয়া = to grasp the hidden meaning.

English Wizard.question: ২১) I will stand by you through________.
English Wizard.option1: ক) might and main
English Wizard.option2: খ) heart and soul
English Wizard.option3: গ) thick and thin
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) black and white
English Wizard.exp: Through thick and thin – সর্বাবস্থায় - under all circumstances, no matter how difficult.

English Wizard.question: ২২) What is the meaning of the phrase ‘white elephant’?
English Wizard.option1: ক) a worthless thing
English Wizard.option2: খ) a precious but worthless thing
English Wizard.option3: গ) a precious thing
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) a giant animal
English Wizard.exp: White elephant = মুল্যবান কিন্তু কাজের নয় এমন বস্তু = a precious but worthless thing.

English Wizard.question: ২৩) ‘Throw cold water’ means –
English Wizard.option1: ক) inspire
English Wizard.option2: খ) calm down
English Wizard.option3: গ) dishearten
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) reject
English Wizard.exp: Throw cold water = নিরুৎসাহিত করা = dishearten.

English Wizard.question: ২৪) ‘Whole nine yards’ means –
English Wizard.option1: ক) a big area
English Wizard.option2: খ) a narrow area
English Wizard.option3: গ) everything
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) all the time
English Wizard.exp: Whole nine yards = প্রাসঙ্গিক সবকিছু = everything.

English Wizard.question: ২৫) ‘Sit on the fence’ means –
English Wizard.option1: ক) avoid making a decision or choice
English Wizard.option2: খ) keep safe
English Wizard.option3: গ) stay on a risky point
English Wizard.option4: ঘ) try to make a reconciliation between two opponents
English Wizard.exp:
Sit on the fence = সিদ্ধান্ত বা পছন্দ বাছাই না করে এড়িয়ে যাওয়া = avoid making a decision or choice
Source : Oxford Languages
